_template.note: Synthetic template for the agricultural ministry of Siaya County, Kenya, which serves the farmers around a hub planned in Siaya. The hub is not open, every person is synthetic, the procedures are written from how county agriculture departments generally work and Siaya's own forms and fees are not checked, and the numbers in the rules are values chosen for the demo.

agency.name: Siaya Farmers' Group
agency.description: The agricultural ministry of Siaya County, Kenya, serving the farmers around a community tech hub planned in Siaya. Its officers advise farmers, keep the list of farmers, plots, animals and groups, answer reports of pests and sick animals, clear animals and produce to move, and decide on subsidised inputs and relief. Farmers also buy inputs from approved suppliers, alone or as a group order, and look for a buyer for their produce, with two AI agents: one for the farmers and one for the suppliers. The hub is planned, not open.

objective_modules.rationale: The farmer's input question is a form; each send opens a thread the Farmers' agent answers in.
The Farmers' agent answers the farmer in the thread the form opened.
A pooled order is a task for the group coordinator to approve.
Each farmer is told their share in a thread.
The Farmers' agent offers a match to the farmer and the buyer in a thread.
Posters post their prices here, the farmer picks a row, and each order and group order is kept here.
The agents ask and answer in the person's own thread.
A visit, a pest report and a training sign-up are forms the extension officer reads; the field report is her own form.
Each request is a task for the extension officer, and each advisory is a task for the agriculture director to approve.
The officer's answer reaches the farmer in her thread, through the Farmers' agent.
Each registration is a form the farmer fills in, or the group coordinator for a group.
Each registration is a task for the officer who confirms it.
The officer's answer, or the correction she asks for, reaches the farmer in her thread.
A sick-animal report and a movement request are forms the veterinary officer reads.
Each report, booking and permit is a task for the officer who says yes.
The officer's answer, and a warning to the other keepers, reach the farmers in their threads.
A subsidy request and a relief request are forms the farmer fills in.
Each request and complaint is a task for the officer or the agriculture director who decides.
The answer reaches the farmer in her thread, and the Suppliers' agent hands a complaint to the supplier.

roles.name: Group coordinator
roles.description: Keeps the farmers' group going. Approves each supplier before he appears in the market, starts the group order and sets its minimum, decides for any farmer who stays silent, adds a row to the group order's Payments record for each farmer who has paid, and answers for the group to suppliers and buyers. This role is held by a person.

roles.name: Farmer
roles.description: A member of the group who grows crops. Says what inputs they need, such as seed or fertiliser and how much, and what produce they have to sell.

roles.name: Supplier
roles.description: A seller of farm inputs, approved by the group coordinator before he appears. Posts his offers with a price and a bulk price in his own words, keeps his own stock, says yes with a date or no when a farmer asks, and marks an order paid.

roles.name: Buyer
roles.description: A person or business that buys the farmers' produce. Posts his price a bag and his bulk price in his own words, and says yes or no for himself when a farmer asks to sell or a group sale is sent to him. Nobody else answers for him, not the Farmers' agent, not the group coordinator. He sees a farmer's name and bags, never a contact.

roles.name: Farmers' agent
roles.description: The group's AI role that speaks to the people who want something. Looks at the posted prices first and asks only the one poster a farmer picked, only what is not already posted; shows the farmer each answer; matches farmers' produce to a buyer's request. It never says yes for a person and holds no supplier threads.

roles.name: Suppliers' agent
roles.description: The group's AI role that speaks to the posters. Helps a supplier post his offers and keep his private stock list, and carries the one question a farmer picked him for. It holds no farmer threads, cannot open an order, and never says yes for a person.

roles.name: Extension officer
roles.description: The ministry's adviser on crops, soil and training. Visits farms, answers pest and disease reports, books soil tests, training days, inspections and the county tractor, confirms farmers, plots, ponds and boats, and drafts the seasonal advisory and the field report. This role is held by a person.

roles.name: Veterinary officer
roles.description: The ministry's adviser on animals. Answers reports of a sick animal, sets vaccination days, confirms livestock, and decides each animal movement permit. This role is held by a person.

roles.name: Agriculture director
roles.description: Heads the ministry. Decides subsidised inputs, relief and complaints about suppliers, approves each seasonal advisory before it goes out, lists farmer groups and cooperatives, and reads each field report. This role is held by a person.

goals.title: Farmers buy inputs together
goals.description: The group's input needs reach a supplier as one order, so each farmer buys on the group's terms.

goals.title: Farmers find a buyer for their produce
goals.description: Farmers see what each buyer pays for their produce and sell it alone or together, at a price the buyer posted himself.

goals.title: Farmers are known to the county and advised
goals.description: Each farmer, plot, herd and group is on the ministry's list, and an officer is a request away for advice on crops, soil and training.

goals.title: Farms and herds are protected and helped
goals.description: Sick animals and diseased crops are answered, animals and produce are cleared before they move, and help reaches the farmers who ask for it.

objectives.title: Gather the farmers' needs into one order
objectives.description: The Farmers' agent collects each farmer's input question and combines them into one pooled order for a supplier.

objectives.title: Get the supplier's answer to the farmers
objectives.description: The supplier confirms what it can fill and at what price, and each farmer is told what their share is.

objectives.title: Farmers sell their produce at a buyer's posted price, alone or together
objectives.description: A farmer sees every buyer's posted price, picks one, and sells now or joins a group sale the group coordinator starts. Nothing is sent when a posted price answers.

objectives.title: Farmers buy from approved suppliers, alone or together
objectives.description: A farmer sees every approved supplier's posted price, picks one, and buys now or joins a group order the group coordinator starts. Nothing is sent when a posted price answers.

objectives.title: Officers advise farmers on their crops and soil
objectives.description: A farmer asks an officer to visit, reports a pest, signs up for a training day or asks for a soil test, and the ministry sends one advisory a season to every farmer.

objectives.title: The ministry knows its farmers, plots, animals and groups
objectives.description: Each farmer, plot, herd, pond, boat and group is listed once an officer has confirmed it.

objectives.title: Animals and produce are healthy and cleared to move
objectives.description: A sick animal is reported and answered, animals are vaccinated, and animals and produce move or are sold only once an officer has cleared them.

objectives.title: County help reaches the farmers who ask
objectives.description: Subsidised inputs, the county tractor and relief go to the farmers who ask for them, and a complaint about a supplier is heard before anything is decided.

values.text: Farmers do better together than alone; what the agents do is something a person could do and the group can check.
An officer's answer is written down with its reason, so the farmer and the next officer can read it.

rules.text: A farmer asks for inputs through the group's form, saying the input, the amount and when they need it.
The Farmers' agent pools the farmers' needs for the same input into one order, and the group coordinator approves the order before it goes to a supplier.
A supplier answers a pooled order with what it can fill and the price; the Farmers' agent tells each farmer their share and the price.
A farmer is bound to an order only after they have said yes to their share.
A buyer posts his price a bag and his bulk price in his own words, and a farmer says what produce she has, how much and when it is ready.
The Farmers' agent asks only the one buyer a farmer picked, and only what his posted price does not already answer; each side agrees its own deal.
Neither agent sets a price, takes a payment or says yes for a person, and neither approves its own draft.
Both agents answer in the language the person writes in.
A supplier or buyer posts his price and his bulk price in his own words, and the Farmers' agent looks at the posted prices first and asks nothing when a posted price answers.
A farmer sees every approved poster's row for a product, each in the poster's own words, and picks; the agents group the rows into products and the group coordinator corrects a wrong grouping.

Buy now asks the one poster the farmer picked, at once; he says yes with a date, or no; if he does not answer nothing happens; the farmer cancels at once unless the agency has a cancel workflow; the poster marks the order paid.

A group order starts from a poster's posted bulk price; the group coordinator starts it, sets the minimum and says when it is ready; it has no closing time; sending is locked below the minimum; the order keeps the price and minimum it started with.

The poster sees the open group order with each farmer's name and amount and no contact, and may ask the farmers to revise through the Suppliers' agent; each farmer answers yes or no, and the group coordinator decides for each one who stays silent while the order waits.
Nothing runs on a timer unless a workflow step sets a time limit: when someone does not answer the agents do nothing and the person waiting decides.
The poster is trusted to be in charge of his stock; the system keeps each yes and never works out stock, and a supplier's private stock list is seen by him alone.
For something not listed the farmer chooses: ask the shops she ticks, once each, or put up a notice every poster sees; her list shows every poster asked and the answer, waiting, yes or no.

The group coordinator approves each poster before he appears in the market; the Suppliers' agent holds no farmer threads and cannot open an order, because a poster's reply is outside text the agent cannot trust.

An officer says yes to every request that needs the ministry's answer, such as a visit, a permit, a subsidy, a tractor or relief; the agents take the request and tell the farmer the answer, and never decide it.
The template sets no fee, subsidy or relief amount; the officer who says yes states it in the officer's own words.
A seasonal advisory goes out only after the agriculture director approves it, and the Farmers' agent sends it in the officer's words.

A report of a sick animal or a crop disease goes to the officer at once; where the officer says it can spread, the Farmers' agent tells the other farmers who keep or grow the same, in the officer's words.
A supplier is heard before the agriculture director decides on a complaint against him, and stays in the market until the director has decided.

workflows.name: Register a fish pond or boat

workflows.description: A farmer reports an animal that is sick or dead. Says yes: the veterinary officer, with what to do or a visit date.

workflows.description: A farmer books her animals into a vaccination day. Says yes: the veterinary officer, with the day.

workflows.name: Request an animal movement permit
workflows.description: A farmer asks to move animals from one place to another. Says yes: the veterinary officer.

workflows.name: Request a produce inspection
workflows.description: A farmer asks for her produce to be inspected before she sells it. Says yes: the extension officer, with a day.

workflows.name: Apply for subsidised inputs
workflows.description: A farmer applies for inputs the county gives at a lower cost. Says yes: the agriculture director, with what he allows.

workflows.name: Book a county tractor
workflows.description: A farmer books the county's tractor for ploughing or planting. Says yes: the extension officer, with a day.

workflows.name: Report a loss and apply for relief
workflows.description: A farmer reports a loss to drought, flood or disease and asks for relief. Says yes: the agriculture director.

workflows.description: A farmer complains about an input she bought, such as seed that did not grow. Says yes: the agriculture director decides what happens to the supplier.

work_items.title: Take the booking
work_items.description: The Farmers' agent asks the farmer which animals and how many, and hands the answers to the veterinary officer.
work_items.prompt: The Farmers' agent asks the farmer which animals and how many, and hands the answers to the veterinary officer.

work_items.title: Confirm the day
work_items.description: Says yes: the veterinary officer, with a day and a place, or no with a reason.
work_items.prompt: Says yes: the veterinary officer, with a day and a place, or no with a reason.

work_items.title: Mark the animals vaccinated
work_items.description: After the day the veterinary officer marks the animals vaccinated and the farmer is told in her thread.
work_items.prompt: After the day the veterinary officer marks the animals vaccinated and the farmer is told in her thread.

work_items.title: Request an animal movement permit
work_items.description: The farmer says which animals, how many, and where they are moving from and to.
work_items.prompt: The farmer says which animals, how many, and where they are moving from and to.

work_items.title: Decide on the permit
work_items.description: Says yes: the veterinary officer approves or declines. Until he does, the animals are not cleared to move.
work_items.prompt: Says yes: the veterinary officer approves or declines. Until he does, the animals are not cleared to move.

work_items.title: Take the request
work_items.description: The Farmers' agent asks what produce, how much and where it is, and hands the answers to the extension officer.
work_items.prompt: The Farmers' agent asks what produce, how much and where it is, and hands the answers to the extension officer.

work_items.title: Book the inspection
work_items.description: Says yes: the extension officer, with a day, or no with a reason.
work_items.prompt: Says yes: the extension officer, with a day, or no with a reason.

work_items.title: Write the result
work_items.description: The extension officer writes whether the produce passed and what to do if it did not; the farmer is told, and the buyer if the farmer asks.
work_items.prompt: The extension officer writes whether the produce passed and what to do if it did not; the farmer is told, and the buyer if the farmer asks.

work_items.title: Apply for subsidised inputs
work_items.description: The farmer says which input she needs, how much, and how many acres it is for.
work_items.prompt: The farmer says which input she needs, how much, and how many acres it is for.

work_items.title: Decide on the application
work_items.description: Says yes: the agriculture director approves, with what he allows, or declines with a reason. The template sets no amount.
work_items.prompt: Says yes: the agriculture director approves, with what he allows, or declines with a reason. The template sets no amount.

work_items.title: Tell the farmer
work_items.description: The Farmers' agent tells the farmer the answer in her thread.
work_items.prompt: The Farmers' agent tells the farmer the answer in her thread.

work_items.title: Take the booking
work_items.description: The Farmers' agent asks what work, how many acres and which day, and hands the answers to the extension officer.
work_items.prompt: The Farmers' agent asks what work, how many acres and which day, and hands the answers to the extension officer.

work_items.title: Set the day
work_items.description: Says yes: the extension officer, with a day, or no with the next day that is free.
work_items.prompt: Says yes: the extension officer, with a day, or no with the next day that is free.

work_items.title: Close the booking
work_items.description: After the work the extension officer marks the booking done and the farmer is told in her thread.
work_items.prompt: After the work the extension officer marks the booking done and the farmer is told in her thread.

work_items.title: Report a loss and apply for relief
work_items.description: The farmer says what was lost, how much, when and where.
work_items.prompt: The farmer says what was lost, how much, when and where.
work_items.form_name: Report a loss and apply for relief

work_items.title: Check the loss
work_items.description: An officer visits and writes what is found: the extension officer for crops, the veterinary officer for animals.
work_items.prompt: An officer visits and writes what is found: the extension officer for crops, the veterinary officer for animals.

work_items.title: Decide on relief
work_items.description: Says yes: the agriculture director approves relief, with what he gives, or declines with a reason. The template sets no amount.
work_items.prompt: Says yes: the agriculture director approves relief, with what he gives, or declines with a reason. The template sets no amount.

work_items.title: Take the complaint
work_items.description: The Farmers' agent asks which supplier, what was bought and what went wrong, and hands the answers to the agriculture director.
work_items.prompt: The Farmers' agent asks which supplier, what was bought and what went wrong, and hands the answers to the agriculture director.

work_items.title: Hear the supplier
work_items.description: The Suppliers' agent hands the complaint to the supplier, who answers in his own words. Nothing is decided before he has answered.
work_items.prompt: The Suppliers' agent hands the complaint to the supplier, who answers in his own words. Nothing is decided before he has answered.

work_items.title: Decide on the complaint
work_items.description: Says yes: the agriculture director decides: no action, a warning, or asks the group coordinator to stop the supplier appearing in the market.
work_items.prompt: Says yes: the agriculture director decides: no action, a warning, or asks the group coordinator to stop the supplier appearing in the market.
